questions.question: What invitation does God give Jeremiah in chapter 33?
options: Gather all of the people and read to them the holy law
Flee at once from the city, for it cannot now be saved
Call to me and I will answer and show you great things
Go up to the high mountain and wait there for my voice
questions.answer: Call to me and I will answer and show you great things

questions.question: What does God again promise concerning David in Jeremiah 33?
options: His royal line would come to a final end
A foreign king would sit upon his throne
His city would be left quite empty and forgotten
A righteous Branch will spring up for David
questions.answer: A righteous Branch will spring up for David

questions.question: Jeremiah 33 promises healing and restoration, with the sound of joy and gladness returning.
Call to me and I will _____ you, and will tell you great and hidden things that you have not known.
In those days I will cause a righteous _____ to spring up for David.
